records.key: Download about 370 MB of example data for Measure: sixteen fields across four wells, already segmented, so Measure can be run without generating masks first. Cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.source: Download about 370 MB of example data for Measure: sixteen fields across four wells, already segmented, so Measure can be run without generating masks first. Cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.translation: Sækja um 370 MB af dæmigögnum fyrir Measure: sextán sjónsvið í fjórum brunnum, þegar hlutuð, svo hægt er að keyra Measure án þess að búa fyrst til grímur. Vistað í skyndiminni eftir það, svo það gerist samstundis ef ýtt er aftur.

records.key: Fetch the four-plate example screen and put its count tables and score tables into the two slots below. About 35 MB the first time; cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.source: Fetch the four-plate example screen and put its count tables and score tables into the two slots below. About 35 MB the first time; cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.translation: Sækja dæmiskimunina með fjórum plötum og setja talningartöflur hennar og stigatöflur í raufarnar tvær hér fyrir neðan. Um 35 MB í fyrsta skipti; vistað í skyndiminni eftir það, svo það gerist samstundis ef ýtt er aftur.

records.key: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.source: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.translation: Sýna umbeðinn fjölda myndskurða sem hafa mælingar líkastar valda myndskurðinum, þeim með hringnum, líkustu fyrst, svo hægt sé að merkja sjaldgæfan flokk sem fannst einu sinni mörgum sinnum. Fyrsta leit í uppsprettu les mælingar hennar og tekur nokkrar sekúndur; síðari leitir eru tafarlausar. Farðu aftur í alla myndskurði með því að opna uppsprettuna aftur. Sjálfgefið ekki keyrt.
